answer: Give every account a plume: a public trail of small, time-stamped actions spread across unrelated services over weeks, impossible to fake in bulk because each action costs real attention. Once a season, a gale sweeps the network: accounts must solve a fresh, human-paced puzzle built from their own plume, tying identity to history. Newcomers start violet, a provisional color with read-only access until their plume survives one gale. A farm can clone accounts but cannot clone months of scattered attention, and bulk-created plumes share the same few timestamps and betray themselves.
